sources.title: Pinellas Doula Services — Jennifer Vazquez
sources.quote: Hi! I'm Jennifer — a certified birth and postpartum doula and childbirth educator serving St. Petersburg and throughout Pinellas County
sources.claim: Pinellas Doula Services (Jennifer Vazquez) is a certified birth and postpartum doula and childbirth educator serving St. Petersburg and Pinellas County.

sources.title: Quantum Motherhood — Tiffany Holmes
sources.quote: Traditional Birth & Postpartum Doula, Hypnobirthing Childbirth Educator, Quantum Birthing Coach, Reiki Master, Pelvic Steaming Facilitator, and Intuitive Guide in St. Petersburg, FL
sources.claim: Quantum Motherhood (Tiffany Holmes) offers traditional birth & postpartum doula care, Hypnobirthing childbirth education, Reiki and related services in St. Petersburg, FL.

sources.title: Bornbir — Madeline Ishmael
sources.quote: My name is Madeline 'Maddy' Ishmael and I am a certified birth doula through DONA since 2019, certified lactation consultant through Healthy Children Project and a prenatal yoga teacher.
sources.claim: Madeline 'Maddy' Ishmael is a certified birth doula serving the St. Petersburg area (Bornbir-verified profile).

sources.title: Healthy Start Coalition of Pinellas — Doula Program
sources.quote: Doula will be with the client during the labor and delivery... Must be a resident of Pinellas County
sources.claim: The Healthy Start Coalition of Pinellas doula program provides continuous labor-and-delivery support to enrolled clients in Pinellas County.

sources.title: Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital Center for Women and Babies
sources.quote: Located on the third floor of Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital, Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital Center for Women and Babies offers labor and delivery suites and maternity care.
sources.claim: Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital's Center for Women and Babies, per its official Johns Hopkins Medicine listing, offers labor-and-delivery suites and maternity care from its third-floor location within the Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital campus at 550 6th Street South, St. Petersburg.

sources.title: HCA Florida St. Petersburg Hospital Women's Center
sources.quote: In our secure labor and delivery unit, we offer private rooms where new families can bond together under the care of certified nurses and skilled physicians.
sources.claim: HCA Florida St. Petersburg Hospital's women's center offers a secure labor and delivery unit with private rooms.

sources.title: Breath of Life Women's Health & Birth Center
sources.quote: Breath of Life Women's Health and Birth Center, located at 1900 East Bay Drive in Largo ... received its CABC accreditation status becoming Florida's only accredited birth center.
sources.claim: Breath of Life Women's Health & Birth Center operates in Largo, FL (serving the St. Petersburg area) as a freestanding birth center.
